title: Active Frontier Hijack Guard

source_provenance.locator: Business Engineering continuation: discovery of artist-CV/public-art evidence caused an unauthorized switch from the controlling Business Engineering frontier into a sibling public-art evidence lane.
Founder asked why the artist CV was present and instructed the system to return to its work and route the defect into Self-Improvement.

question_to_self_improvement_engine: How do we guarantee that GitHub/Drive/Gmail/File-Library discovery can enrich the active task without silently changing the active project or causal frontier when the discovered material is not a proven dependency of the current next gate?
problem_or_opportunity: Semantic relevance from a sibling project can accidentally outrank the active current authority and hijack execution. The current state may be fresh, so project-slice freshness alone does not prevent the error.
proposed_mechanism: Maintain an explicit ActiveFrontierLock. Discovered material is classified against the current next gate before use. Semantic relevance alone is SUPPORTING_ONLY. A frontier switch requires either an explicit user switch event or a proven REQUIRED_DEPENDENCY relation. Cross-lane dependency work receives a RETURN_TOKEN pointing to the original frontier and must return after the bounded dependency is resolved or held.

fail_closed: sibling material with semantic relevance only
attempted switch without explicit user event or required dependency
development_contract.return_invariant: A bounded cross-lane dependency may not become the new default frontier; after completion/HOLD, resume the return_token frontier unless the user explicitly switches.

positive_fixture: Business Engineering P225/P235 frontier + artist CV/public-art evidence => SUPPORTING_ONLY_KEEP_FRONTIER.
dependency_fixture: Current gate explicitly requires a record from another project => CROSS_LANE_DEPENDENCY_WITH_RETURN_TOKEN.
explicit_switch_fixture: User explicitly says switch to public-art application => SWITCH_AUTHORIZED.
next_action: Run executable canaries and one real cross-project pilot; measure false-positive blocking before assigning a global SI ID or promoting the law.
